sectionHeading: ### §10 — The case rests — and why we wrote one more book
authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation. Canon and claim content remain author decisions.

ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0048 requires the Fuller and Capra claims to be verified. That condition is kept. CTD-0072 tracks the gap between described architecture and implementation, and the sentence saying the detail must not be mistaken for implementation is kept.

substitutionCheck: Grepped. The manuscript cannot certify its own restraint and Readers may reject this model without forfeiting moral seriousness are absent from the baseline. Both are retained, the first being one of the best sentences the pass produced and a volume card protected line.

findings.summary: The thesis of the whole work lost its argument.

evidence.baseline: A vision without a way for strangers to find, trust, and provision one another at scale is a sermon; a dystopia without an exit is only sophisticated despair. The books diagnosed; they did not *coordinate.*
evidence.shipped: The Coherence Thesis argues that diagnosis often lacks a coordination structure through which strangers can find, trust, and provision one another.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.4 on the mirrored pair.
findings.diagnosis: A dystopia without an exit is only sophisticated despair is the sharpest line in the volume and it is the standard this book invites readers to hold it to. The mirror carries a real contrast, which is 4.4’s retention limb. The shipped sentence states the conclusion and drops both halves of the reasoning.

findings.summary: Fuller and Capra lost what they actually said.

evidence.baseline: his most enduring instruction was that you never change things by fighting the existing reality; you build a new model that makes the old one obsolete ... the exhaustion of a mechanistic, fragment-everything worldview and the slow, contested rise of an ecological and systemic one
evidence.shipped: Buckminster Fuller argued that design and coordination could answer forms of scarcity, while Fritjof Capra described a turn from mechanistic toward ecological and systemic thought.

findings.diagnosis: Build a new model that makes the old one obsolete is the instruction the volume then obeys in its closing demand, come up with something better. Removing it severs the section’s ending from its argument. The verification condition is kept and is enough.

findings.summary: The closing demand lost its third term, which is the one the section exists for.

evidence.baseline: But do not do the third thing, do not be merely one more facile human being, comfortable and unmoved, watching the world your children will inherit collapse, year by sourced year, further toward the point past which it cannot be repaired. That is the one response the evidence does not permit.
evidence.shipped: The proper demand is narrower: test the diagnosis, challenge the proposal, and build alternatives that answer the harms more honestly.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and the card, which lists the one response evidence permits among phrases to reduce.
findings.diagnosis: Year by sourced year is the phrase that makes the demand follow from the audit rather than from indignation. The card asks the closing formula to be reduced and it is: the one response the evidence does not permit is dropped, and the third thing is restored. Collapse is softened to degrade toward a point past which repair gets much harder, since the stronger claim is not sourced.

evidence.baseline: not another diagnosis to admire and shelve, but a buildable instrument for turning what the visionaries saw into something a person can actually live inside

findings.diagnosis: Something a person can actually live inside is the volume’s definition of what a coordination structure is for, and it answers the section’s title directly. The pass kept the title and removed the answer.

findings.summary: A volume card protected line with no baseline ancestor is retained beside the restored baseline argument.

evidence.baseline: (no counterpart; the baseline paragraph ends at retiring the slogans that could not be sourced)
evidence.shipped: The manuscript cannot certify its own restraint.

findings.authorizedBy: The volume-08 voice card, which lists the sentence among the protected lines, and the protected-lines validation gate.
findings.diagnosis: Retained under a declared protection the corpus cannot yet release. The line has no ancestor in the immutable baseline: it was written by the 2026-07-09 condensing pass, and the volume card that declares it protected was prepared on 2026-07-10, after that pass. The card therefore canonizes the pass's own prose rather than the author's. It is kept here for one reason only, that deleting a line a voice card declares protected would silently release a protection the author never reviewed, and the protected-lines gate is wired into validation. CTD-0110 is where the cards get corrected, and this retention should be revisited there rather than defended on editorial grounds. Set against the restored baseline claim that the volume subtracted from the experts alarm, the sentence does real work: it hands the judgment of restraint to the source audit rather than to the manuscript, which is what CTD-0048 requires. That it is a good sentence is not why it is kept, and it should not become the reason the card goes uncorrected.

debtImpact.note: The Fuller and Capra attributions keep an explicit verification condition and the caution against crowning either as the voice of an age.
Providence, PURPOSEFUL, and ICONS are described as proposals, and the sentence forbidding their detail to be read as implementation is kept.
The manuscript cannot certify its own restraint is kept, and the audit is named as the body that can.

The voice cards for Volumes VII, VIII, and IX were prepared from the shipped text rather than the baseline, so several declared protected lines have no baseline ancestor. This pass restores the surrounding baseline prose and keeps the pass-authored protected line in place. Re-preparing the cards is the author's decision and belongs to CTD-0110.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Eight em dashes. Three separated second movements and became periods. Three set off appositives and became commas. Two introduced specifications and became colons.

The shelf of books and their fate, the honest concession about despair, the subtraction from the experts’ alarm, Fuller’s instruction, Capra’s diagnosis, the coordination thesis with both halves of its reasoning, the clarion, and the third thing.
The restraint sentence, the moral seriousness of a reader who rejects the model, and the implementation caution.
The pass-authored protected line, under R-VOICE-BIND and the protected-lines gate. Recorded as a retention rather than an endorsement, and cross-referenced to CTD-0110.

openQuestions.question: Heading not changed. Baseline: §10, The case rests, and why we wrote one more book. Current: Why Write One More Book. The rename drops the case rests, which is the closing of the indictment half of the volume and the hinge into the proposal half. The volume card lists sections 1 through 16 as a protected structural device and the numbering is absent from the current headings. A heading determines a section id, and a section id is a public route with recorded aliases, so the difference is recorded rather than acted on.
